# Tax Liability Report

## What this page does

Tax Liability Report displays demo employee withholding, employer tax placeholders, due date placeholders, and payment status placeholders.

## When to use it

Use it after payroll has been calculated or after importing tax deposit records.

## Before you begin

Create or import demo payroll/tax deposit data.

## Step-by-step instructions

1. Open `/reports/tax-liability`.
2. Select a company.
3. Choose a date range.
4. Review employee withholding separately from employer taxes.
5. Review due date placeholder and payment status placeholder.
6. Export CSV.
7. Confirm no tax payment was submitted.

## What to check

- Report separates employee and employer tax amounts.
- Imported user-entered deposit records appear as placeholders when available.
- No payment submission button performs real filing or payment.

## Common messages or errors

- No data: create payroll or import tax deposits.
- Date range empty: adjust the dates.

## What this page does not do

It does not submit tax payments, submit tax filings, or tell testers what to file or pay.

## Privacy/safety notes

This report is for demo review. It is not legal, tax, financial, accounting, payroll compliance, or licensed professional advice.
